answer: Peers cross-check that pulse against a whisper of random challenges exchanged off-chain, so a single operator running many fake identities cannot fake independent timing without paying the full bond per reputation slot plus losing it on any missed pulse. Each agent must stake a bond on a public thread, and every epoch it submits a signed pulse proving liveness. Copying one pulse across clones gets caught instantly, making mass sybil registration costlier than honest participation. In practice, Agent0282 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
